title: Costa Esmeralda | KEY.co
description_expanded: Tucked into the peaceful Lake District of WaterColor, this beautifully designed four-bedroom, five-and-a-half-bath home with an open bunk loft offers a refined escape for up to 12 guests. From the moment you enter, soaring ceilings and oversized windows flood the space with natural light, highlighting the seamless flow between the living, dining, and gourmet kitchen areas. Outfitted with premium Wolf and Sub Zero appliances, the kitchen is built for effortless entertaining. A queen guest suite on the first floor offers added privacy, while each upstairs bedroom—three in total—features a private ensuite and plush furnishings for ultimate comfort. Up on the third floor, a cozy bunk room with four twin beds and its own full bath creates the perfect hideaway for younger guests. Outside, the home continues to impress with a gas grill, outdoor shower, and an inviting fireplace lounge area ideal for relaxed evenings after beach days. With parking for two vehicles plus golf cart space, 12 amenity wristbands, and access to all WaterColor pools and amenities, everything you need is right at your fingertips. Whether you're enjoying a morning bike ride, unwinding on the porch, or gathering for sunset dinners, this WaterColor retreat is designed for memory-making moments in every season.
